review_summary: Comprehensive Review (Chidzidzo 42) consolidates Lessons 36, 37, 38, 39, 40, 41. Key structures mastered in this block include Zezuru alliterative subject/object concords (zvivakashure), agglutinative tense/aspect markers (-no- habitual, -ka- past, -cha- future), and high/low tone patterns across: Mupanda 5/9 Nominal or Verbal Stem; Mupanda 9 (i-/dzi-) Noun; 1st Person Sg Recent Past Concord (nda-); Mupanda 16 Locative Prefix (pa-). Example utterances reviewed: "ndine nhumbu asi ndaona pa pant pangu paine ropa saka ndandichida kuziva kuti ndoita sei? ndoenda kuchipatara here?" | "ndingadawo kuziva zvekudya zvinokurudzirwa madzimai akazvitakura nezvekudya zvisingakurudzirwi kwatiri isu vanenge vakazvitakura" | "handidi kuita imwe mimba parizvino ndingada kuziva kuti ndeapi matanho e familiy planning andingatora kudzivirira kudzivirira pamuviriri"

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndine nhumbu asi ndaona pa pant pangu paine ropa saka ndandichida kuziva kuti ndoita sei? ndoenda kuchipatara ______?' (Expectant mother's health inquiry in Zezuru: 'ndine nhumbu asi ndaona pa pant pangu paine ropa saka ndandichida kuziva kuti nd')
